remainingBlockers.title: 1 false-positive split detection / audit validity
remainingBlockers.finding: The audit's false-positive measure is not independent of the detector, and an independent SEC-share-count label shows a materially higher false-positive rate than the 1.2.0 rationale claims.
evidence: scripts/quant/price-integrity-audit.mjs:273-277: falsePositiveCandidate = !(plausible && persistsOrSpike); SEC share count is not decisive, persistence alone clears a hold.

quant/engines/price-integrity.js explainDay: 'if (up && match && (sig || ...))' -> cause UNDECLARED_REVERSE_SPLIT whenever the core signature fires; confidence HIGH for sig && persists, regardless of secSharesRatio.

Independent label on rebuild.newHolds (SPLIT_SUSPECTED_UNDECLARED, n=90): 58 no SEC evidence; of 32 with SEC evidence: 13 SPLIT (shares x k within x1.5), 5 LEAN_SPLIT (shares x k <= 3), 14 CONTRADICTED (shares fell far less than 1/k), 5 of them with shares unchanged within +-1%.
Only 7 of the 14 contradicted holds carry falsePositiveCandidate=true; one hold with a ~25x jump and SEC share ratio 1.000 is labelled UNDECLARED_REVERSE_SPLIT/HIGH.
Contradicted by path: VOLUME_INVERSE 9/18 SEC-evidenced, EXACT_RATIO_OVERNIGHT 4/13, OUT_OF_RANGE 1/1.
Commit e049f4c claims 2/11 false for k>=5 in 1.1.0; for 1.2.0 the independent rate is 16% (strict, shares unchanged) to 44% (broad) of SEC-evidenced holds.
remainingBlockers.remedy: Define FP/TP solely by an independent label (SEC shares ratio vs 1/k, pre-registered tolerance) and report precision with CI per path; never let forensic cause derive from CTR.undeclaredReverseSplitSignature. Set a pre-registered acceptance threshold for precision before re-running.

remainingBlockers.title: 2 false-negative split detection / residual extreme returns
remainingBlockers.finding: Large residual of undeclared extreme raw jumps remains inside canonical-valid bars; several SEC-confirmed reverse splits still pass as returns; no detection at all for the downward direction.
evidence: QUANT-PRICE-INTEGRITY-REBUILD.json corporateActionConsistency.undeclared10xJumpsInsideCanonicalBars.after = 188 (190 under 1.1.0).

known83: 48/83 still extreme (UNRESOLVED 12, UNDECLARED_REVERSE_SPLIT 4, DECLARED_SPLIT_INCONSISTENT 1, DECLARED_SPLIT_DATE_SHIFT 1, GENUINE_PRICE_MOVE 30). All 2213: still-extreme with defect cause UNRESOLVED 21, UNDECLARED_REVERSE_SPLIT 7, STALE 3, UNIT 1, DATE_SHIFT 1, INCONSISTENT 1.
Golden G-KNOWN-FN-10.3X: SEC confirms ~1:11, volume 0.40x > 3/k -> passes as a >+1000% month (authors label it a blocker).
An overnight ~1115x jump with day volume 1.04x of median passes (OUT_OF_RANGE path requires volume < median).

k-selection defect: k is chosen as nearest to the close only, then open is tested against that k. Cases 23.5x close / 19.7x open (both within 25% of k=20; SEC shares fell ~7.5x) and 148x / 236x (SEC shares fell ~70x) are rejected.

Raw census: 296 >=10x downward daily jumps (UNRESOLVED 145, FORWARD_SPLIT_POSSIBLE 35, CURRENCY_OR_UNIT 33, PROVIDER_SPIKE 36 ...); the core returns null for r<1 except reverted spikes (PI18 documents this).
remainingBlockers.remedy: Choose k minimizing max(|log(close/k)|,|log(open/k)|); add a frozen down-direction/unit rule (HOLD on >=10x moves with forward-split or unit signature, or SEC-confirmed); use SEC shares, when available at t, as a confirming path; report residual count inside the intended calibration universe.

remainingBlockers.title: 2/6 V4-D2 high adjusted level
remainingBlockers.finding: Of 74 securities with split-adjusted level > 1e6, 13 carry a defect cause; 11 of those remain canonical without any core quarantine. Only 1 was newly quarantined by the fix.
evidence: rebuild.highLevelFate: UNDECLARED_JUMP_IN_HISTORY 9 unquarantined (first jump cause: 6 forward-split-possible, 2 unresolved, 1 date shift), DECLARED_SPLIT_INCONSISTENT 2 unquarantined, both V4 SPLIT_ARTIFACT, core state TOTAL_RETURN_RECONSTRUCTED.
Core event band 0.4..2.5 accepts declared-split-day gross 2.0-2.5 that the forensic (and V4 band 2) call inconsistent.
V4 price-sanity-v4 cuts SPLIT_ARTIFACT downstream, but classifies 10-50x undeclared jumps as GENUINE (UNIT_JUMP_RATIO=50); quant consumers have no such layer.
remainingBlockers.remedy: Quarantine these from the defect event by a frozen cause-based rule in the core (align core event band with the forensic band or HOLD on inconsistent split days); re-measure.

remainingBlockers.title: 3 survivorship / terminal handling
remainingBlockers.finding: HOLD is effectively permanent and in V4 becomes a DATA_QUARANTINE terminal whose handling is outcome-correlated; no classical survivorship (valid prefix kept), but informative censoring.
evidence: No confirmation path exists in canonical-total-return.js (no override/allowlist); 'until a corporate-action source confirms' is not implemented.

data.mjs:267-281 slices raw at the event, terminal kind DATA_QUARANTINE; runner.mjs:147 censors any signal horizon containing it; accounting.mjs:81-88 settles at last pre-event close x scenario factor.
runner.mjs:104 injects the terminal bar with rawClose: Infinity, so the DISTRESS_ZERO scenario test rawClose<1 can never fire; 89 of 106 new holds have a sub-dollar prior close.
Bars removed 87,790 (~830 per hold); DELISTED terminals 3195->3156 replaced by DATA_QUARANTINE (proceeds treatment changes).
remainingBlockers.remedy: Normalize SEC-confirmed cases instead of holding; pre-register censoring counts by reason and a worst-case treatment of DATA_QUARANTINE in sensitivity; carry lastRawClose in the injected bar (separate V4 PR).

remainingBlockers.title: 4 point-in-time / causality
remainingBlockers.finding: Split signature is causal (bars <= t; observedAt == from for all 90). PRICE_SPIKE_REVERTED is detected at t+1 but quarantined from t, and the V4 consumer keys eligibility and settlement on terminal.date, not observedAt: one-session look-ahead. A single reverted bad tick also ends the series permanently.
evidence: 16 holds with observedAt = from + 1 session, all PRICE_SPIKE_REVERTED.
data.mjs:382 and :461 'terminal.date > asOf' excludes the security on the spike day; accounting.mjs:84 settles on terminal.date.
canonical-total-return.js revertedSpike returns date of bar i-1; reconstruct returns UNAVAILABLE for everything after, although the series is valid after the revert.
remainingBlockers.remedy: Invalidate only the spike bar (or use observedAt for eligibility/settlement) and continue the series after the revert; test with a prefix ending on the spike day.

remainingBlockers.title: 8 universe shrinkage / cross-consumer impact
remainingBlockers.finding: V4 coverage loss is modest, but outside V4 a hold removes the whole total-return history, and this was not measured.
evidence: scripts/quant/lib/daily-prices.mjs:56: tr = ctr.reconstructed ? ... : null; whole-series unavailability (no prefix) for signal/setup backtests, survivorship control; also used by scripts/market/refresh-benchmark-history.mjs and scripts/vorsorge/ingest-tiingo-etfs.mjs.

Fixture evidence in quant/tests/total-return-contract.test.mjs and benchmark-reference.test.mjs: one decades-old undeclared event removes a published long series from the study (titles 58->57, TR coverage 93.3%->91.7%).
CLAUDE.md: changes to quant models need their own PR with a before/after comparison; none exists for these consumers.
remainingBlockers.remedy: Either adopt prefix semantics in daily-prices (as V4 does) or gate the new reasons behind an opt-in for non-V4 consumers; produce the before/after for quant consumers.

remainingBlockers.title: 6 currency / unit
remainingBlockers.finding: Unit changes are accepted (policy CURRENCY_OR_UNIT -> UNRESOLVED_PRICE_DISCONTINUITY -> ACCEPT); there is no core rule for them, and no currency check in the core.
evidence: Raw census: 39 unit-ratio jumps (33 down >=10x).
1 extreme -99% month still extreme with cause CURRENCY_OR_UNIT.
All extremes are on US exchanges; no non-USD evidence.
remainingBlockers.remedy: Fold into the R4 down-direction rule; pre-register.

remainingBlockers.title: 10 result-driven thresholds
remainingBlockers.finding: The 1.1.0->1.2.0 revision is partly justified by independent evidence (k=2/3 SEC-contradicted 51/53), but it is in-sample and not a pure tightening: two new detection paths were added after seeing the 83 cases, and the forensic labeler that defines the evaluation was changed at the same time.
evidence: git diff dbb9aba e049f4c: undeclaredSplitOutOfRange (>=100x) and undeclaredSplitExact (2%) paths added; persistence rule and an intraday-squeeze GENUINE rule added to explainDay.
Goldens are drawn from the audit cases (e.g. G-D1-EXACT-40X 'from the 83 list').
Same data, different labels: in83 root causes UNDECLARED_REVERSE_SPLIT 16->23, UNRESOLVED 32->20, GENUINE 26->32 between runs.
No correlation or performance used (confirmed in code).
remainingBlockers.remedy: Freeze the rules; measure precision/recall on a held-out label set (SEC-labelled jumps not in the 83, or a held-out period) with a pre-registered pass threshold; decouple the forensic labeler from the core.

remainingBlockers.title: 4 point-in-time (pinned V4 consumer)
remainingBlockers.finding: The V4 price-sanity layer that still runs after the core only applies its defect checks to securities whose maximum split-adjusted level over the full history exceeds 1e6. That level depends on future reverse splits.
evidence: price-sanity-v4.mjs classifyPriceLevel: returns null unless max(close) > 1e6 over all bars; adjusted closes are back-propagated from later splits; called in loadPrepared before the calibration.
remainingBlockers.remedy: Retire the level-conditioned layer in favor of the core's cause-based rules applied to all securities, or apply its defect checks unconditionally; declare it in the new protocol.

note: No calibration was started, no strategy measured, no claim produced.
